en: A single day on the planet Venus takes longer to complete than its entire year around the Sun.
Pumice is the only natural rock on Earth that is light enough to float on water.
Astronaut footprints on the Moon will remain visible for millions of years because there is no wind to erase them.
The red supergiant star Betelgeuse is so huge that it would swallow the orbits of Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars.
The 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo released so much ash that it temporarily cooled the entire Earth's global climate.
If all water vapor in Earth's atmosphere rained down at once, it would cover the globe in just 2.5 centimeters of water.
A single handful of healthy soil contains more living microorganisms than the total number of humans on planet Earth.
Lightning strikes the surface of the Earth approximately one hundred times every single second of every day.
Diamonds are made entirely of pure carbon, which is the exact same element found in the graphite of your pencil.
The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth at a steady rate of about 3.8 centimeters per year.
Neutron stars are so incredibly dense that just one teaspoon of their material would weigh six billion tons on Earth.
Tsunamis can travel across the deep ocean at speeds up to 800 kilometers per hour, as fast as a commercial jet.
